title: Ordering a Simple Meal
objective: Request a table, order a meal, and ask for the bill
situation: You are having dinner in a restaurant with one other person.
closing_display_text: Thank you. I hope you enjoyed your meal.
closing_spoken_text: Thank you. I hope you enjoyed your meal.

turns.assistant_display_text: Here is the menu. Are you ready to order?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Here is the menu. Are you ready to order?
turns.user_display_text: Yes, I would like the vegetable soup, please.
turns.user_expected_text: Yes, I would like the vegetable soup, please.

turns.assistant_display_text: What would you like for your main course?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: What would you like for your main course?
turns.user_display_text: I would like the grilled chicken and rice.
turns.user_expected_text: I would like the grilled chicken and rice.

turns.assistant_display_text: Would you like something to drink?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Would you like something to drink?

turns.user_display_text: No, thank you. Can I have the bill, please?
turns.user_expected_text: No, thank you. Can I have the bill, please?

turns.assistant_display_text: Of course. Will you pay by cash or card?
turns.assistant_spoken_text: Of course. Will you pay by cash or card?
turns.user_display_text: I will pay by card. Thank you.
turns.user_expected_text: I will pay by card. Thank you.
